convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'AFIRMA' custom indicator, and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management, money management, and trade execution which contains complex logic for lot calculation and position close/open routines

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before trading

other_exits: Long closed when AFIRMA[1]>AFIRMA[2] (downtrend detected) and BuyPosClose is enabled
Short closed when AFIRMA[1]<AFIRMA[2] (uptrend detected) and SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: FREEMARGIN=deposit fraction from free margin, BALANCE=deposit fraction from balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=loss share from free margin, LOSSBALANCE=loss share from balance, LOT=fixed lot; default input is LOT with MM=0.1

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic: AFIRMA buffer 1 is read at bars [SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2]. Downtrend is detected when Value[1]<Value[2] (AFIRMA declining). In downtrend, if Value[0]>Value[1] (AFIRMA turning up), a BUY signal fires. Uptrend detected when Value[1]>Value[2] (AFIRMA rising). In uptrend, if Value[0]<Value[1] (AFIRMA turning down), a SELL signal fires. This is a mean-reversion strategy on the AFIRMA filter: buy when the adaptive filter turns up during a decline, sell when it turns down during a rise. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates every tick without waiting for a new bar. The Recount flag ensures signals are recalculated on data copy failure. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can individually disable long entry, short entry, long exit, and short exit.
python_conversion_notes: The AFIRMA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is an adaptive FIR moving average with configurable window functions (Rectangular, Hanning1, Hanning2, Blackman, Blackman-Harris) and tap count. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must be fully analyzed to replicate BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions, CIsNewBar class, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_. Position sizing has 5 modes controlled by MarginMode enum; default input uses LOT (fixed lot). SL/TP are in points (not pips) so digit adjustment depends on symbol. Signal timestamp (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to open functions - need to verify if this is used for pending order logic or just logging. The entry is a mean-reversion pattern on AFIRMA: trend-down + filter-turning-up = buy; trend-up + filter-turning-down = sell.
